headline: Priority Software Acquires Fireberry to Expand AI-Driven ERP Capabilities
summary: Priority Software has acquired Fireberry to integrate CRM, marketing automation, and customer service tools into its cloud-based ERP platform. The move aims to accelerate the company's AI-first business management strategy.
why: Priority Software is a provider of cloud-based ERP solutions, and acquisitions in this space are typically aimed at expanding service offerings and increasing market share in the enterprise software sector.

impacts.name: Priority Software
impacts.why: The acquisition expands the company's product portfolio and AI capabilities.
